commands_used: answer 1. I am Tarin, a thief freed from the Owing barge by Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa. She works for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the Secret Warriors of the Xeech-Leel who rule the province. The Hists along the river are sickening, including Jal-Veesa Hist (dry bark, closed scar, cooling egg-pool). I do not know the cause. 2. Ask Vosh-Leera for her second task, in her house in Jal-Veesa. 3. I can talk to her, or first ask Weeltul the tree-minder about sap, scar, eggs and Umbriel. No big choice yet. 4. I do not understand why the trees sicken, or what Umbriel did beyond the 4E 48 story. I could find out by asking Weeltul and Vosh-Leera.

answer 1. Vosh-Leera gave me a cup of Jal-Veesa sap, drawn before the scar closed. Trees are joined at the root, so drinking it lets me ask where the sickness is and see what the trees show. 2. Drink the cup here in front of Vosh-Leera, then tell her everything I see. 3. Drink it now, or first ask Weeltul more questions. I see no other choice yet. 4. I do not know what the vision will be or if it is safe. I have the Hist blessing against poison. I could find out by drinking it.

answer 1. I drank the sap and saw a young grey Hist among pale stilt huts, a woven weir across a creek, and west of the weir a reed hide beside a lone dead tree with clay jars stacked in its shade. Presumably this shows where the sickness is. 2. Tell Vosh-Leera what I saw, here at Jal-Veesa. 3. Tell her everything, or hold something back. I mean to tell her all. 4. I do not know where this place is, what the hide and jars mean, or whether the dead tree is the cause. Vosh-Leera may know.

answer 1. The vision showed Teel-Fen Weir, a Sedge-Wardens camp south of Jal-Veesa where a young Hist grew from Jal-Veesa roots. Jars by the hide suggest someone is keeping sap there. Vosh-Leera told me to be careful at the hide. 2. Go to Teel-Fen Weir and speak to Heem-Jasa, the tree minder, on the platform round the tree. 3. Go there directly, or visit Weeltul first. I will go to Heem-Jasa. 4. I do not know who keeps the sap in the hide, or if the dead tree matters. Heem-Jasa may tell me.

answer 1. Strangers, the Unbound Sap-Takers, are draining Hists of sap and sealing the scars with grey paste. Heem-Jasa saw it three nights ago on her young tree. They have a reed hide west of the weir by a lone dead tree. 2. Take the Note to the Sap-Takers from the reed hide west of Teel-Fen Weir. 3. Fight the three Sap-Takers, shoot them from the reeds east of the hide, or creep to the open west side where the jars are and take the note unseen. 4. I do not know who the Unbound are, who they serve, what the grey paste is, or why they take sap. The note may tell me.

answer 1. I took the note. The Sap-Takers crew master orders them to bring jars to Karsh-Naal Camp and seal every scar behind them. 2. Return to Heem-Jasa on the platform at Teel-Fen Weir. She will ask if her tree will live. 3. Be straight with her, and she teaches alchemy and sells to me, or ease her with a kind word, after which she will not deal with me. I mean to comfort her. 4. I do not know who the crew master is, where Karsh-Naal Camp is, or why they seal scars.

answer 1. The quest is done. I comforted Heem-Jasa that her tree will live; she gave three Cure Poison potions but will not teach or sell to me. Sap-Takers drain Hists and seal scars; their jars go to Karsh-Naal Camp. 2. Go to Karsh-Naal Camp, a Naga camp in the marsh east of Teel-Fen Weir. 3. Go there and investigate, or tell Vosh-Leera first. 4. I do not know who is behind the Sap-Takers or why they take sap, or whether I told Heem-Jasa a lie. I could learn at the camp.

answer I am Tarin, a thief working for Vosh-Leera of Jal-Veesa, who serves the Toh-Reel-Ka. Hists are sickening. I drank Jal-Veesa sap and saw Teel-Fen Weir, south of Jal-Veesa. There Heem-Jasa minds a young Hist whose scar was sealed with grey paste. Unbound Sap-Takers drain trees and seal scars. I took their note from the reed hide without a fight. It says to bring jars to Karsh-Naal Camp, a Naga camp in the marsh east of the weir. I told Heem-Jasa her tree will live, the comforting choice. She gave me three Cure Poison potions but will not teach or sell to me. I have about 50 gold, a lockpick, the Hist blessing (resist poison), the note and the potions. Next: go to Karsh-Naal Camp. Still unknown: who leads the Sap-Takers, what the paste is, and what Umbriel did. Weeltul at Jal-Veesa has untried topics.
